justifications.type_expressiveness: Newtype JobId, typed JobState enum, typed QueueError variants, and an internal Job struct with Option<Instant> for retry timing — every meaningful distinction has a type.
justifications.error_handling: Typed QueueError with distinguishing UnknownJob/NotRunning variants, Display implemented, library never panics in normal paths, and the only expect has a documented reason while overflow is handled via saturating arithmetic.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Narrow public surface, complete derives on JobId/JobState, Display on QueueError, and every public item has a doc comment with consistent std-style naming.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with ?, map_or, matches!, and proper derives, but the checkout selection uses a manual loop with awkward match-based min tracking instead of iterators.min_by_key, and payload is cloned rather than borrowed.
